ops.summary: Start an agent session (Shelf Chat, Investigate, Safer Alternative, report draft, Shopper Agent step, Research Agent)
ops.description: One endpoint, one mode per ADK agent (engine/agents). Every step is returned in `steps` and written to the investigation trace under `investigation_id`. Colours are set by code, never by a model or by page text. Shelf Chat is also owner help: charger compatibility, plug setups, household suitability, pressure tactics on a shop screenshot, symptoms ("my charger gets hot"), incident reports, warranty and support requests, repair or replace, safe disposal, a manual (document), and the household's products with warranty and return dates and family sharing (X-Owner-Ref). Its owner-help results are in `assist`. With X-Owner-Ref the chat remembers the conversation (session_id) for a day: leave out product_id, history and the manual on a follow-up and the remembered ones are used. It also looks up specs on the web, compares products, files an incident report once the shopper says yes, and offers tappable answers in `quick_replies` ({question, options}).

params.name: X-Owner-Ref

ops.summary: Investigate any product (seen before or not) against live official sources; deep = durable job
ops.description:
Market from the shop URL, currency or `market`. Identity is read-only. Official sources for that market and
global upstream sources are queried in parallel; every record is checked for source authenticity, claim
support, exact model / variant / batch scope and country; copies count once; the outcome is set by code:
confirmed_recall | substantiated_hazard_signal | potential_concern | no_matching_notice_found |
insufficient_evidence. `coverage` says country by country what was checked, how and when.
With `depth: deep` the answer is a job ({status: queued}); poll GET /v1/investigations/{id}.
Send `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe.
